name: 404-found
description: Production-grade AI-powered Lost & Found platform for university campuses

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
